services.active: On sale in the POS and the customer app.
services.inactive: Hidden from the POS and the app; its data is kept.
services.ppn: VAT is added to the base price; the final price includes it.

outlets.inactive: Takes no orders and is hidden from the app.
outlets.open: Open right now, by the outlet's opening hours (Asia/Jakarta time).

materials.active: Can be used in recipes and stock.
materials.inactive: Cannot be picked for new recipes or stock.

variants.rule: The customer must pick exactly one option.

modifiers.optional: The customer may skip it (up to the maximum, if set).
modifiers.required: The customer must choose at least the minimum shown.

accounts.inactive: Not in use; cannot sign in.
accounts.banned: Blocked: cannot sign in or order.

stock.negative: Recorded stock is below zero: count what is really on the shelf.
stock.low: At or under the minimum level: time to reorder.

history.consumption_reversal: A use undone because the order was cancelled.
history.waste: Thrown away: expired, damaged, spilled or lost.

activity.failed: The server refused it; the HTTP status is shown.

banners.active: Published: shows whenever its schedule allows.
banners.inactive: A draft: never shown in the app.
banners.scheduled: Active, but its start time has not come yet.
banners.ended: Active, but its end time has passed.

vouchers.active: Published: customers can claim and use it whenever its window allows.
vouchers.inactive: A draft: nobody can claim or use it.
vouchers.live: Can be claimed and used right now.
vouchers.scheduled: Active, but its start time has not come yet.
vouchers.ended: Active, but its end time has passed.
vouchers.code: Claimed by typing its code, or sent by staff.
vouchers.public: In every wallet while it is live.
